concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-capital-webhook-types-capital-webhooks]] — 2026-09-15 Capital dynamic/static-offer and grant-status webhook reference separating offer, grant, grant-account and balance-account identifiers from separate fund-transfer booking evidence.
warnings: Requested, Approved and Pending grant events do not by themselves prove disbursement; fund-transfer/booking evidence is separate, and Repaid samples are not a named user's final debt proof.
The renewal minimum and active principal in sample payloads are not a reusable eligibility threshold; only some listed stages have detailed samples.
